notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first worked throughout - curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome110) direct GET on every page, no blocks, no CAPTCHA. robots.txt checked first: only disallows admin/cache/query-string paths and named bad-bot scrapers; no Claude/anthropic-ai directive, so all tiers were permitted (only tier a was needed). TREE: built from union of (1) homepage mega-menu (248 nav links captured), (2) categories.xml sitemap (site-wide category slugs), (3) each candidate page's own H1/canonical/qty and, for Curtains and Storage Furniture, an embedded 'react_data' sub-category tile widget that revealed real child pages not present in the header mega-menu. WoodenStreet is a furniture-first retailer; textile/storage are a genuinely thin slice as expected. QTY: read the '(<N> Products)' span next to the H1 on each category page (verified against rugs-and-carpets = 38 Products as the pattern reference); this matched the site's own displayed count on every row recorded. Every recorded leaf's canonical URL and H1 were confirmed to match the requested slug (no silent parent/site-wide fallback numbers observed). EXCLUDED (Textile): Pillows/Memory Foam/Cervical/Cuddle/Body Pillow (/pillow, 14 products) - site nav groups these under 'Mattresses & Pillows' (a sleep/orthopedic-support furniture-adjacent category, same shelf as memory-foam mattresses), primary material is latex/memory foam not fabric, and textile.md only lists Pillowcases/Pillow Shams (not raw filled pillows) - treated like the excluded Mattress category. Sofa Throws (/sofa-throws) and Blankets (/blankets) - both genuine 404s (dead links still present in the home-furnishing landing tiles), no page to record. Tapestries/wall textiles, apparel, pet textiles - none found on site. Curtains room/color/size SEO variants (bedroom-curtains, living-room-curtains, home-curtains, all-curtains all =86 Products identical to each other; transparent-curtains=sheer-curtains=26; sliding-door-curtains=long-door-curtains=door/long-curtains duplicates; plus color/size/price filter slugs) - confirmed via direct fetch to be byte-identical product counts to an already-recorded canonical slug, so treated as duplicate/View-All-style SEO pages per rule 27 and kept only one row per distinct product set. Rug/carpet SEO variants from categories.xml (area-carpets=38 dup of rugs-and-carpets, bedroom-rugs=living-room-rugs=rugs=3 all identical, round-rug, dari-carpet, jute-carpets, hand-tufted-carpets, 4-ft-x-6-ft-carpets, carpet-for-bedside) - these were only reachable via a generic footer 'trending searches' cross-link block that also linked totally unrelated categories (wall clocks, office chairs), i.e. not a genuine sub-category strip, and the ones checked were exact duplicate counts of the already-recorded Rugs And Carpets node - not recorded. EXCLUDED (Storage): Living Storage/Storage Furniture hub (/storage-furniture) and its children Living Cabinets, Bedroom Cabinets, Kitchen Cabinets, Bar Cabinets, Wooden Showcase, Crockery Units, Hutch Cabinets, Cabinet & Sideboard, Display Units, Bookshelves, Chest of Drawers, File Cabinets - product-level check confirmed these are all wooden sideboard/cabinet/bookcase FURNITURE (e.g. 'Prestige Low Height File Cabinet In Fumed Oak With Lock', 'Tiros Mango Wood Cabinet with Arched Glass Door') reached via /kitchen-furniture, /study-room-furniture, /bedroom-furniture, /living-room-furniture furniture nav sections - Furniture per storage.md Sec 21/27 boundary, not Storage. Kitchen Racks (/kitchen-racks, 3) - standalone solid-wood freestanding furniture racks under the /kitchen-furniture URL - Furniture, not Storage. Cutlery Holders (/cutlery-holders, 2) - decorative wooden spoon-stand/napkin-holder tabletop accessory, not a drawer/storage organizer - Kitchen & Dining decor, not Storage. Storage Drawers (/storage-drawers, 20) - product check showed these are the same wooden 'Chest Of Drawers' furniture already excluded above (duplicate of chest-of-drawers, Furniture). Storage Bench (/storage-bench, 4) and Kids Storage (/kids-storage, 1) - both are furniture (upholstered storage bench, kids wardrobe-with-bookshelf) - Furniture, not Storage. Storage Baskets (/storage-baskets, 3) and Cloth Organizer (/cloth-organizer, 3) and Desk Organizer (/desk-organizer, 1) - product-level check showed each is a byte-identical duplicate listing of an already-recorded node (Laundry Baskets and Table Organizer respectively) under a different SEO slug - not recorded separately. Storage Organizers (/storage-organizers, 12) - product check showed it is an overlap/aggregate pulling items already counted individually under Storage Containers and Laundry Baskets (same grain-dispenser and laundry-trolley products) - not a distinct product line, excluded as a duplicate aggregate. Solid Wood Trunk and Blanket Box (/solid-wood-trunk-and-blanket-box, 3) - confirmed subset of the main Trunk & Blanket Box listing (4) - not recorded separately. Storage Bags (/storage-bags) - genuine 404, no page exists. Bathroom Storage Designs (/bathroom-storage-designs, 1) - byte-identical duplicate of Bathroom Storage (same single product) - not recorded separately. Hydraulic Storage Beds, Beds With Storage, Divan Beds With Storage - all genuine BEDS (furniture) despite 'storage' in the name/slug - Furniture per both rule files. Kitchen Storage (/kitchen-storage, 29) - product check showed 'Kitchen Cabinet'/'Sideboard' furniture, same as the excluded Living/Bedroom Cabinet set - Furniture, not Storage.
